We attempted to check matching of template 1914384 to target molecule; result False. Applying template gave empty result. So template not applicable directly. Perhaps need to deprotect or modify? The task says "use the template/s ['1914384'] in this order." Means we must include that template in route, maybe as a reaction step. Even if not directly applicable, maybe we need to propose precursors that when combined via that template give target. So we need to apply template in reverse (retrosynthetic) to get precursors. The apply_template function applies retrosynthetic template to target, returning precursors. It returned empty, meaning template not applicable. Could be because template expects certain pattern not present. Maybe need to deprotect? The molecule has a hydroxyl on a bridgehead carbon and a CF3 group. Template maybe for oxidation? Not sure.

We could try to get template details via get_template to see SMARTS.
